$comment: AUTHORITY for the words of the Smelter's refusals and of the messages it logs that a reader of its output relies on (SMELTER.md), word for word. A text's `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says, and nothing else in it varies. `refusals` is each refusal of an operation, the `message` of its failure. `logged` is each message the Smelter logs, at its `level`, with the facts named in `fields`, each of the form given, and the facts named in `carries` beside them.

refusals.name: rebuild-incomplete
refusals.situation: A rebuild of anchored text that could not do every resource it set out to (SMELTER.md § Rebuild): `{failed}` is how many it could not do, and `{total}` how many it set out to do, each in decimal digits.
refusals.message: {failed} of {total} resources failed to re-anchor: see the Smelter's log

logged.name: not-indexed
logged.situation: A resource the Smelter decided not to index (SMELTER.md § What it decides): `{resourceId}` is the resource, `{reason}` the `reason` its `smelt:settled` carries, `{mediaType}` the media type its bytes were read as, and `{checksum}` the checksum of those bytes.

logged.name: content-unread
logged.situation: A resource whose bytes the Smelter could not read (SMELTER.md § What it decides): `{resourceId}` is the resource. `error` says why.
logged.message: Smelter could not read resource content

logged.name: event-failed
logged.situation: An event the Smelter could not apply because its embedding provider failed a request (SMELTER.md § The embedding provider): `{resourceId}` is the event's resource, `{provider}` the provider's `type` (EmbeddingConfig), `{model}` the model it was asked for, and `{status}` the status it answered with. `slice` is which request of the batch it was, and `error` says why.
